answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the sable of free entry disappears, the jetty of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the umber case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
